import { agentJobs } from "../db/schema"
import type { AgentJobDatabase } from "./job-store"

export function createLocalJobApiJob(db: AgentJobDatabase, request: { id: string; prompt: string }) {
  db.insert(agentJobs)
    .values({ id: request.id, source: "api", runtime: "codex", status: "queued", mode: "plan", cwd: "/fixture", promptPreview: request.prompt })
    .run()
  return request.id
}
